translation: Master Cheng Jingtong is a pure Confucian scholar, and he is also versed in medicine. I have never studied medicine myself, but once I encountered Master Cheng taking the pulse and explaining illness, there was no whole person in my eyes; subtle words and lofty discourses appeared in layers, hearing what I had not heard and understanding what I had not understood. How nearly Master Cheng approaches medicine! I also saw him treating people: even for the extremely poor and lowly, once he took up a case he would always ask carefully and examine thoroughly, reflect and think precisely, and never show a look of weariness or sloth.
